testId: tests/webstore/CartCheckoutPage/CartCheckoutPageTest.spec.ts > SAN-026 EDG-021 EDG-004 SAN-016: Shop As shows the impersonated user's page and cart only

scenario.summary: An Admin with an empty own cart uses Shop As on a created Market Coordinator and then a created Sales Rep: the Questionnaire follows the impersonated role and the impersonation header stays visible; after End Impersonation the Admin's own cart is empty and shows none of the Sales Rep's items or address.
steps: Sign in on the storefront (config webstoreURL, /login) with the tester's own Admin account (config adminUsername / adminPassword, from env ADMIN_USERNAME / ADMIN_PASSWORD); the Web Admin Dashboard (/admin) opens
Open the Header Cart; if the own Admin account's cart has lines, remove them; check 'Your cart is empty' (EDG-004 precondition)

In Web Admin open Users, find the created Market Coordinator by its user name (@coordinator.userName) and choose Shop As; the storefront opens as that user with the impersonation header (EDG-021 step 1, SAN-016 step 3)
Open the PDP /product/{@product.parentProductId}; the size grid is shown; enter 1 for @product.variant1Attr1 and click Redeem Now (EDG-021 step 2)
Check the Questionnaire section is shown and the impersonation header is visible (EDG-021 step 3, SAN-016 step 4)

End Impersonation; In Web Admin open Users, find the created Sales Rep by its user name (@salesRep.userName) and choose Shop As; the storefront opens as that user with the impersonation header (EDG-021 step 4, SAN-026 step 1)
Open the PDP /product/{@product.parentProductId}; the size grid is shown; enter 2 for @product.variant1Attr1 and click Redeem Now (EDG-004 step 1, SAN-026 step 2)
Check the Order Summary lists @product.variant1Sku with quantity 2 and the Questionnaire section is shown (EDG-004 step 2, SAN-026 step 3, EDG-021 step 4, SAN-016 step 2)
Click End Impersonation in the storefront header (EDG-004 step 3)
As the Admin open the Header Cart (EDG-004 step 4)
stateChanges: The Sales Rep and Market Coordinator users, their allotments and the Sales Rep address are created for the test by their collections; at teardown the allotments are deleted, the user and its addresses are kept on qa (test users are not deleted, user decision 2026-11-27)
The own Admin account's cart emptied at the start
Cart lines on the created users
assertions: While impersonating the Market Coordinator and the Sales Rep the Questionnaire section is shown (page follows the impersonated role, not the Admin role)
The impersonation header stays visible on the combined page
After End Impersonation the Admin's page shows 'Your cart is empty' with a PLP link
The Admin's page shows neither @product.variant1Sku nor the Sales Rep's address (@addressRep.address1)
evidence: Jira BMP-94 (story, FSD section 'Shopping Cart and Checkout', work/stories/BMP-94/input/) and manual cases SAN-026, EDG-021, EDG-004, SAN-016 (work/stories/BMP-94/input/BMP-94-testcases.md)

work/stories/BMP-94/analysis.md section 6: every role test signs in with the tester's own Admin account and reaches the created user through Shop As (user decision 2026-11-26); created users never sign in with a password, so 'signed in as <role>' in the cases is reached through Shop As

PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_SIZE_GRID (existing BNJM size-grid products, no price rule: BNJM variants are priced 0.00; user decision 2026-11-27) replaces the hardcoded /product/798 (BM05) and size Small of the cases; on qa product 798 (SKU BM05) is configured by attribute Size (ZnodePimConfigureProductAttribute -> PimAttributeId 129, AttributeCode Size), so variantAttributes = Size

Allotments: BIWW Allocations custom table, linked to the rep only by SalesRepEmail (analysis section 9); one ALLOTMENT_OF_USER_FOR_VARIANT need per variant the test enters, quantity = the highest quantity the test reaches for it

Partially automated: SAN-016 'client linked to the address, pre-filled' and 'Questionnaire required' need a client in the BIWW Clients custom table (Checkout 3 story): no key yet. SAN-016 step 1 'sign in as the Sales Rep' is reached through Shop As (user decision 2026-11-26)
The own Admin account is shared: its cart is emptied at the start; parallel runs with the same account would collide
EDG-021 names a tester account as the Market Coordinator; not used (created user)

sources.value: the Sales Rep item or address on the Admin page
